# airflow-systemd

> Apache Airflow integration for systemd-managed jobs

## Pages

- [airflow-systemd](index.html.md): Run and monitor systemd-managed jobs from Apache Airflow.
- [Tutorial: run your first systemd job](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): We will run a five-second service from Airflow, monitor its completion, and remove its unit file and saved configuration.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): Run systemd services on an Airflow worker or an SSH host, with configuration in Python or airflow-config YAML.
- [Why Airflow owns the schedule](docs/src/explanation.html.md): Airflow coordinates workflows; systemd owns service processes, their children, and their resource groups. airflow-systemd connects those responsibilities by...
- [API reference](docs/src/api.html.md): All names below are exported from airflow_systemd.
